article.title: Giving constructive feedback professionally
article.description: Useful framework: start positive, then the specific issue, then a suggestion. Phrases: 'One thing that worked really well was...', 'One area to consider improving is...', 'Going forward, it might help to...'. Avoid absolute negative language like 'this is wrong' — softer framing keeps the conversation constructive.

Ever struggle to give feedback without sounding harsh? Keep it constructive! Start positive, then address the specific issue, and finish with a helpful suggestion. Use phrases like 'One thing that worked really well was...' and 'Going forward, it might help to...' for professional conversations.

generated.script:
Kisi ko feedback dete time, 'yeh galat hai' bol dete ho, aur woh bura maan jaata hai?
Toh suno! Professional feedback dene ke liye ek simple framework follow karo. Pehle shuru karo positive se. Bolo: 'One thing that worked really well was...' Isse saamne waala comfortable ho jaata hai. Phir, specific issue ko soft tarike se batao: 'One area to consider improving is...' Aur end mein do ek suggestion: 'Going forward, it might help to...' Ye sab use karke, aap positive aur constructive feedback de sakte ho.
Ab samajh aaya ki professional feedback kaise dete hain? Isse saamne waale ko bura bhi nahi lagega, aur woh improve bhi karega.

slides.body: Giving constructive feedback professionally is crucial for fostering growth and clear communication. A useful framework involves starting with a positive observation, then addressing the specific issue, and finally offering a helpful suggestion for improvement. You can use phrases like 'One thing that worked really well was...', 'One area to consider improving is...', and 'Going forward, it might help to...'. Always avoid absolute negative language like 'this is wrong' to maintain a supportive and constructive tone.
